ops.text: long-running drive: a builder lane cannot declare the After install: step its own goal names. drive job brief <j> --after is refused from a lane (a lane runs only job report, job ask, job set, job replies, job held, pr add, pr set, ...), and drive job set has no --after, so j6557 had to ask the coordinator over Orca to add 'drive order set o2046 --every 15' after its install. Fix: give drive job set an --after (append, drive verbs only, same check as job brief) so the builder that learns of the step records it on its own job.
